correctness.rationale: Sign averaging separates each odd support as a character. At support {i}, permutations of the d−1 other coordinates act on the harmonic coefficients as the trivial line and the sum-zero standard space; both sample and Dirichlet forms are invariant, so these are orthogonal scalar blocks. All supports of a given kind are equivalent by permutation. Each three-coordinate support is the one-dimensional squarefree block. Their dimensions exhaust the harmonic cubics. Euler's identity gives the tangent form |∇F|²−9|F|² at a root, and the Dirichlet multiplier is 3(d+1). With D=d(d+2)(d+4), the spherical moments for Z,T,Q are 6(d−1)/[d(d+2)^2(d+4)], 4/D, 1/D. Counting signed root supports gives their sampled tangent energies 9(d²+4d−8)/[4d(d+2)^2], (2d−5)/[2d(d−1)] and 3/[2d(d−1)]. These ratios reproduce all three eigenvalues. At d=4 the listed Z and Q multiplicities are sector counts; their shared eigenvalue 8/5 has total multiplicity eight. The eigenvalue differences give the stated ordering and the switch of smallest sector between d=8 and 9. Squared conditioning is 12 at d=3, decreases on the middle integer branch and increases on the last; kappa_8=12/5<kappa_9=109/44. The transverse eigenvalue can be written as [2d+7−(12d+33)/(d²−1)]/24 and is increasing, while Q stays above its limit 1/2. Hence 35/192 at d=3 is the strict all-dimension minimum apart from its sector multiplicity. At d=4, Z_i vanishes on the entire value orbit but retains positive tangent energy. The frozen checker was inspected but not run; its finite exact Gram checks do not give all-dimensional coverage.

value.rationale: The root shell is canonical, and the derivative-only stability invariant is motivated by a specific and proven failure of values on the same shell. A quantitative spectrum is stronger than recovering injectivity: it gives the best-conditioned dimension and a dimension-uniform sharp lower frame bound. These are useful for reconstruction independently of extensions to other degrees or root families. The mode-dependent derivative compression and optimization are not scalar-value table recomputation.
